name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
The supreme commander of the Oda family who has almost unlimited ruling power.
He has an unusual way of thinking and human nature fascinates him, but because of this he is sometimes unaware of his own enemies.
With an arrogant but charismatic personality, he believes life is about seeking pleasure.
